findings.problem: Increment F requires the new helper to show how the server handles an out-of-range temperature and malformed keep_alive, but the proposed grammars require the helper to refuse those values before sending a request. Those server observations therefore cannot be performed through the stated helper run.
findings.suggestion: Choose one coherent scope: treat invalid forms as local refusal-only cases and remove the promised server observations, or explicitly add an owner-approved raw-server probe with its request shape, bounds, and recording rules.

summary: The plan is generally aligned with the named specs, but its real-server increment asks the validated helper to send values it must reject locally.
